high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from Brett Adcock (@adcock_brett) on X (formerly Twitter). The tweet announces that Shanghai-based Fourier has released a rendered video showcasing its GR-3 humanoid robot. It mentions that the real version of the robot is expected to debut in two weeks. The tweet includes a video thumbnail showing a humanoid robot standing upright inside an egg-shaped structure. The robot appears to be white with a simple design, featuring a rectangular head with two circular eyes and a small mouth.
